attributes.action: INCREASE FUNDING TOWARDS MENTAL HEALTH FACILITIES/SERVICES
attributes.additional_details: better treatment of young people in mental health services, including less use of restraint and more choice in their care. Young people should feel safe, respected and listened to, not frightened in a place where they came for help. Staff need more in-depth training and empathy. use appropriate (even upgrade) technology to improve accountability and ensure concerns/complaints/incidents can be properly investigated, rather than becoming one person’s word against another’s.
attributes.background: increase funding for mental health services, including improved facilities, better staff training and greater awareness of mental health. young people should have a much stronger voice in how mental health services are designed, delivered and improved. As they are the ones living in it.

rejection.details:
Your petition is about something that the Scottish Government and Scottish Parliament is responsible for. That means that the UK Government and Parliament can't look into it. 

The Scottish Parliament has its own Public Petitions Committee. If you'd like to send your petition to the Scottish Parliament, you can find out more here: https://petitions.parliament.scot/

You may also wish to contact your local council and MSP who represent you about this issue. 

You can find the name of your local council and how to contact them here: https://www.mygov.scot/find-your-local-council

You can find the name of your local MSP and how to contact them here: https://www.parliament.scot/msps
